subject: 🎬 Meituan LongCat Avatar: photo+audio to lip-sync video, MIT free
intro: The theme today is efficiency hiding in plain sight . OpenAI finally ships transparent backgrounds in GPT-Image-2 (one API call instead of two tools chained together). Claude cuts automation round trips by 20-40% by batching actions. Matryoshka LM trains a whole model family for 36% less compute. The pattern? Every lab is quietly eliminating the tax we pay for AI to work. Fewer steps, fewer calls, fewer training runs. Less is becoming the new moat.

news.headline: New open-source model turns a photo and audio clip into a talking video
news.body: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 just dropped from Meituan's team, and it does something that used to cost a full production studio: give it a photo and an audio clip, and it spits out a realistic talking-head video with tight lip sync. The old problem with AI avatars? They'd fall apart fast. Hands would distort, faces would drift, lip sync would break. LongCat is heavily optimized for stability, long-form generation, lip sync quality, and multi-character interactions, not just cherry-picked demos. Here's what you can actually build with it: Fair warning on self-hosting: it needs a 40 GB GPU, and takes about 44 seconds of compute for every 1 second of finished video. No beefy GPU? Use the fal.ai API instead. It's MIT-licensed, meaning free for commercial use. The repo and weights are public on GitHub and Hugging Face.
bullets: Photo + audio to video : one image, one voice clip, full talking avatar out

Broadcasting, acting, singing, e-commerce, animation, and animal characters
Video continuation: extend existing clips seamlessly

news.headline: OpenAI adds transparent background support to GPT-Image-2 API
news.body: Big news: GPT-Image-2 now supports transparent backgrounds in the API, currently in preview. This was a long-requested feature that was flat-out missing since launch. So what does transparent background actually mean? Simple: the image has no background at all. Just the subject, floating on nothing. You can drop it onto any color, photo, or design without any extra editing. Before this, if you wanted a clean cutout from GPT-Image-2, you had to generate the image, then run it through a separate background removal tool. Now it's one API call. What you can build with this: To use it: set output_format to PNG and background to transparent in your API call. OpenAI also teased more transparency features coming soon.

news.headline: DeepSeek drops free open-source coding agent framework that rivals $200/month tools
news.body: DeepSeek Harness just dropped, and it's a free, open-source framework for building coding agents. Think of a coding agent as an AI that doesn't just answer questions, it actually opens files, runs commands, and completes multi-step tasks on its own. The core idea is simple: everything is a plugin . The model, the tools, the sandbox (an isolated environment where code runs safely), the UI, even the agent's decision loop. You swap any piece just by changing a config file, no touching the core code. This is the exact infrastructure layer that other companies sell as a premium product. It's now free. Still a developer preview, so expect rough edges, but the community is already building plugins fast.
bullets: Works with DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Gemini, or any model you want
